chapter.heading: Ephesians 2
By Grace Through Faith
chapter.v: dead in the trespasses and sins
the sons of disobedience—
children of wrath, like the rest of mankind.
because of the great love with which he loved us,
by grace you have been saved—
seated us with him in the heavenly places in Christ Jesus,
kindness toward us in Christ Jesus.
it is the gift of God,
so that no one may boast.
that we should walk in them.
the circumcision, which is made in the flesh by hands—
having no hope and without God in the world.
by the blood of Christ.
in his flesh the dividing wall of hostility
new man in place of the two, so making peace,
reconcile us both to God in one body through the cross, thereby killing the hostility.
near.
one Spirit to the Father.
members of the household of God,
the cornerstone,
a holy temple in the Lord.
into a dwelling place for God by the Spirit.
